title: Chêne
description: Join Chêne Gear for an evening of outdoor films, storytelling, conservation, and community at the The Carolina Theatre. Featuring a curated selection of short films from past Chêne Film Fests, the evening highlights waterfowl culture, hunting tradition, conservation, and the people who shape the outdoor community. Guests can enjoy a casual happy hour, merchandise, guest speakers, and an immersive film experience designed to bring the Charlotte outdoor community together. Inspired by the spirit of Chêne Fest, this event offers a unique night centered around film, culture, and connection. Whether it is a date night, an off-season gathering with friends, or simply a chance to connect with others who share a passion for the outdoors, we look forward to welcoming you for the evening.

title: PJ Morton - Saturday Night Sunday Morning Tour
description: PJ Morton is a soul singer, songwriter, performer and producer based in New Orleans. He is a 6x GRAMMY-winner and 22x GRAMMY nominee who has earned numerous nominations for BET, Soul Train and NAACP Image Awards, in addition to selling out countless shows at historic venues like the Apollo Theater and others around the world. On top of running his own record label (Morton Records) and serving as Maroon 5's full-time keyboardist for the past 15 years, he has collaborated with Stevie Wonder, Erykah Badu, Jon Batiste, Nas, Lil Wayne, JoJo, Jill Scott and many others.

title: Charlotte Pride Parade Viewing Party + Showgirls (1995 film)
description: The Carolina Theatre will host the Charlotte PRIDE Parade Viewing Party, featuring musical entertainment by DJ Fannie Mae, along with a special vendor market, curated by The Mimosa Way, showcasing Black- and LGBTQ-owned businesses in celebration of both Charlotte PRIDE and National Black Business Month. The afternoon concludes with a screening of the beloved cult classic SHOWGIRLS, which will include pre- and post-show talk back moderated by Mae. Doors open at noon, festivities begin at 1 p.m., and the film starts at 5 p.m. Tickets include admission to the screening of SHOWGIRLS.
